def _interest_states(self, seq: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        emb = self.item_emb(seq)
        if self.transition_keys.numel() > 0:
            previous = torch.cat((torch.zeros_like(seq[:, :1]), seq[:, :-1]), dim=1)
            pair_keys = previous * (self.itemnum + 1) + seq
            indices = torch.searchsorted(self.transition_keys, pair_keys.contiguous())
            safe_indices = indices.clamp(max=self.transition_keys.numel() - 1)
            matched = (
                previous.ne(0)
                & seq.ne(0)
                & indices.lt(self.transition_keys.numel())
                & self.transition_keys[safe_indices].eq(pair_keys)
            )
            counts = torch.where(
                matched,
                self.transition_counts[safe_indices],
                torch.zeros_like(seq, dtype=self.transition_counts.dtype),
            )
            scale = 1.0 + 0.05 * counts / (counts + 5.0)
            emb = emb * scale.to(emb.dtype).unsqueeze(-1)
        emb = self.dropout(emb)
        out, _ = self.gru(emb)
